div.div: In the compiled XML each aggregate version carries its position:

div.div: Each aggregate gets a position. It comes after everything that precedes it in a chain; aggregates that no chain separates keep the default order. An XSLT sorts by it. If two names get different positions, a chain must connect them; otherwise the ordering is rejected as not a strict weak order. A cycle is rejected too.
